en.bilal-muhammad: Al-Hasan b. `Abdullah b. Sa`id narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Ahmad b. Hamdan b. al-Mughira al-Qushayri narrated to us. He said: Abu'l Harish Ahmad b. `Isa al-Kilabi narrated to us. He said: Musa b. Isma`il b. Musa b. Ja`far b. Muhammad b. `Ali b. al-Husayn b. `Ali b. Abi Talib (as) narrated to us in in 250 AH.  He said: My father narrated to me from his father from his grandfather Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father from his forefathers from `Ali b. Abi Talib (as)

regarding the saying of Allah, “Can the reward for good be other than good?” [55:60] He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (s) say: What can the reward of one who has been blessed with monotheism be other than Paradise?
